summary: Air T, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that on June 10, 2026, through its subsidiaries, it completed a reorganization of its aviation asset management platform and the acquisition of Arena Aviation Partners B.V. As part of the transaction, Air T and a management-affiliated entity acquired the remaining 10% common interest in Crestone Asset Management from MRC Parties for aggregate cash consideration of $6.2 million ($3.1 million each). Immediately after, Air T and the affiliate redeemed ~99% of their CAM common. The acquisition merges Arena into the Crestone Air Partners platform. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The filing does not specify closing timelines or an expected close date. Watch for integration updates and any post-closing adjustments.
